title: Branching Inside Bodies: case...of vs. if...end
solutionExplanation: Demonstrates case...of pattern matching on HTTP response tuples and if...end guard chains for latency grading.

otpDocCards.signature: case Expr of Pattern -> Body end.
otpDocCards.description: Evaluates Expr and executes the first matching pattern branch.
otpDocCards.complexityNote: Compiled into efficient jump tables and pattern decoders.

mentalModelCheck.question: What occurs if an Erlang if...end expression evaluates without any condition matching and without a true -> branch?

options.label: The process crashes with an if_clause runtime exception
options.explanation: Erlang if statements must match at least one branch; otherwise an if_clause exception is raised.

options.label: The if statement silently returns the atom undefined
options.explanation: Erlang never supplies implicit return values; unhandled cases crash explicitly.

options.label: The expression re-evaluates the first clause in an infinite loop
options.explanation: Erlang evaluates conditions once from top to bottom.
